UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Publishing Menu Items', 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items', '

Menu items are like picture frames: they show your articles on the site. In this tour you see what happens when you unpublish menu items, articles or a category.

Ready for you: the category World News with the articles Trade Summit Ends in New Agreement and Central Bank Holds Interest Rates Steady, and two menu items in the Main Menu: Top Story shows Trade Summit Ends in New Agreement, World News is a blog of the category.

Look at your site first: click Site in the toolbar of the Joomla Playground, then try both menu items.

This tour follows the tutorial 7.2 Publishing Menu Items of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_content","com_categories","com_menus"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 7.2 Publishing Menu Items', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'Menus', '

In the menu on the left, click Menus.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'Menus › Main Menu', '

Click Main Menu in Menus.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'The Main Menu', '

Here are the menu items of the Main Menu, with Top Story and World News.

', 3, 'bottom', '#menuitemList', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'Unpublish a menu item', '

Click the green tick of World News to unpublish it.

', 4, 'right', '#menuitemList tr:has(a[title$=" World News"]) [data-item-task="items.unpublish"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'And the other one', '

Click the green tick of Top Story.

', 5, 'right', '#menuitemList tr:has(a[title$=" Top Story"]) [data-item-task="items.unpublish"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'The menu items are gone', '

Look at your site and reload the page: both menu items are gone from the Main Menu. A menu item must be published to show, and visitors need a menu item to reach the articles.

', 6, 'bottom', '#menuitemList', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'Publish the menu items again', '

Click the grey cross of World News.

', 7, 'right', '#menuitemList tr:has(a[title$=" World News"]) [data-item-task="items.publish"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'And the other one', '

Click the grey cross of Top Story.

', 8, 'right', '#menuitemList tr:has(a[title$=" Top Story"]) [data-item-task="items.publish"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 9, 'right', 'body.com_menus.view-items #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 10, 'right', 'body.com_menus.view-items #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'Unpublish an article', '

Now the articles. Click the green tick of Trade Summit Ends in New Agreement to unpublish it.

', 11, 'right', '#articleList tr:has(a[href*="task=article.edit"][title$=" Trade Summit Ends in New Agreement"]) [data-item-task="articles.unpublish"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'And the other one', '

Click the green tick of Central Bank Holds Interest Rates Steady.

', 12, 'right', '#articleList tr:has(a[href*="task=article.edit"][title$=" Central Bank Holds Interest Rates Steady"]) [data-item-task="articles.unpublish"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'Menu items without articles', '

Look at your site and reload the page: both menu items are still in the Main Menu.

  • Top Story shows an error: its article is unpublished.
  • World News shows an empty list: a blog shows only published articles.
', 13, 'bottom', '#articleList', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'Publish the articles again', '

Click the grey cross of Trade Summit Ends in New Agreement.

', 14, 'right', '#articleList tr:has(a[href*="task=article.edit"][title$=" Trade Summit Ends in New Agreement"]) [data-item-task="articles.publish"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'And the other one', '

Click the grey cross of Central Bank Holds Interest Rates Steady.

', 15, 'right', '#articleList tr:has(a[href*="task=article.edit"][title$=" Central Bank Holds Interest Rates Steady"]) [data-item-task="articles.publish"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'Content › Categories', '

Click Categories in Content.

', 16, 'right', 'body.com_content.view-articles #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'Unpublish the category', '

Last, the category. Click the green tick of World News to unpublish it.

', 17, 'right', '#categoryList tr:has(a[title$=" World News"]) [data-item-task="categories.unpublish"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'Menu items without a category', '

Look at your site and reload the page: both menu items are still there, but both show an error now. The articles are published, but they need a published category too.

', 18, 'bottom', '#categoryList', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'Publish the category again', '

Click the grey cross of World News.

', 19, 'right', '#categoryList tr:has(a[title$=" World News"]) [data-item-task="categories.publish"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-menu-items'), 'Well done!', '

Everything is published again, and both menu items work on your site.

Remember: a menu item can still show in the menu when the article or category it links to is unpublished. Visitors then get an error.

', 20, 'bottom', '#categoryList tr:has(a[title$=" World News"])', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
